message: In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), Sam, the single-day loading of fifty crates has peak labour and cooling overload problem. To check it I used staged-intake division reusing the 1000 kilogram total mass check (E7) to form the 4-day staged fill calculation (E12). I found 4.0 days at 250 kilogram per day, according to National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH, workplace lifting authority), 1991. I propose capped 250 kilogram per day intake filling twin racks over four days. My position: ready because staged intake fits harvest flow and caps daily lift. In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), Maya, the shared reusable crates and room surfaces has decay spread and neglected upkeep problem. To check it I used field practice review with the cooperative loading workflow sketch (E8). I found daily chlorinated-water washing prevents cross-lot decay, according to Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO, United Nations food agency), 1989. I propose external wash slab with chlorinated water plus pay-per-crate cooperative ownership with trained local caretaker, according to Oorja Development Solutions, 2023. My position: ready because cleaning plus ownership is field-proven for smallholders.
